newsitem.title: EGYPT: Medinet Nasr H1 profits up - report.
newsitem.headline: Medinet Nasr H1 profits up - report.

text.p: Medinet Nasr Housing and Development made pre-tax profits of 67.5 million pounds ($20 million) in the first half of the financial year 1996/7, 49 percent up on 45.4 million in the same period of the previous financial year, a government newspaper said on Tuesday.
The newspaper al-Gumhuria quoted company chairman Taher el-Maghraby for the figures. Company executives were not available to confirm them.

Medinet Nasr, one of the most active stocks on the Egyptian stock exchange, said in early January it had just made a windfall profit of 70 million pounds by selling its stake in sister company Heliopolis Housing and Development.
The newspaper did not say if the company had taken this profit into account in the first-half figures, which cover the period July-December 1996.
In the whole of 1995, Medinet Nasr made net distributable profits of 52.21 million pounds in all of 1995/96, 43 percent up on 36.53 million in 1994/5.
